```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / 
    NULLIF(AVG(pa.overall_rating), 0) AS rating_weighted_win_rate
FROM main."Match" m
CROSS JOIN main."Player_Attributes" pa
WHERE m.date = '2013-12-01'
  AND pa.date = '2013-12-01'
```
